description: Get a fully denormalized Pokémon dossier in a single call — base stats, types, abilities (with full English effect text), height/weight, resolved evolution chain, sprite URLs including official artwork, species flavor text, variety list, capture rate, growth rate, gender rate, legendary/mythical flags, egg groups, and (optionally) a summarized learnable-move list. Accepts a name (lowercase, hyphens for spaces, e.g. "bulbasaur", "mr-mime") or PokéAPI Pokémon-record ID. A species name with no Pokémon record of its own (e.g. "deoxys") resolves to the default variety of that species ("deoxys-normal"), reported in resolvedFromSpecies. Set include_moves=true to include the move summary (large); defaults to false. Use game_version to select flavor text from a specific game (e.g. "sword", "red"); falls back to the most recent English entry when the version is not found. Use pokeapi_find_pokemon to discover Pokémon by type, generation, or egg group before calling this tool.

game_version.description: PokéAPI version name to filter flavor text (e.g. "sword", "red", "scarlet"). Falls back to the most recent English entry when the version is not found.

identifier.description: Pokémon name (lowercase hyphenated, e.g. "bulbasaur", "charizard-mega-x") or PokéAPI Pokémon-record ID as a string (e.g. "1", "10034"). A species name (e.g. "deoxys") resolves to its default variety.

include_moves.description: Include the full learnable-move summary. Defaults to false because the list is large (100–200+ moves).

name: pokeapi_get_pokemon

condition.description: Compatibility summary of the first alternative; evolutionDetails contains the complete methods.

evolutionDetails.description: All alternative methods in upstream order; empty for a base stage. Requirements apply within each method, never across alternatives.

allowedNatures.description: Allowed nature names. Empty lists are preserved; null when unspecified.

expression.description: Verbatim upstream RPN condition expression; not evaluated.

variables.description: Names of expression variables in upstream order.

conditionExpression.description: Variable-dependent condition supplied by PokéAPI. Null when unspecified.

gender.description: Required gender ID. Null when unspecified.

heldItem.description: Required held item. Null when unspecified.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the expected main-series evolution for its variety. Null when unspecified.

item.description: Item used for evolution. Null when unspecified.

knownMove.description: Required known move. Null when unspecified.

knownMoveType.description: Type of a required known move. Null when unspecified.

minDamageTaken.description: Minimum damage taken. Null when unspecified.

minMoveCount.description: Minimum move uses. Null when unspecified.

nearSpecialRock.description: Whether proximity to a Moss Rock or Icy Rock is required. Null when unspecified.

needsMultiplayer.description: Whether multiplayer link play is required. Null when unspecified.

needsOverworldRain.description: Whether overworld rain is required. Null when unspecified.

partySpecies.description: Species required in the party. Null when unspecified.

partyType.description: Type required in the party. Null when unspecified.

relativePhysicalStats.description: Required Attack relative to Defense: 1 greater, 0 equal, -1 less. Null when unspecified.

requiredPokemonForm.description: Required starting form. Null when unspecified.

timeOfDay.description: Required time of day. Empty string is preserved; null when unspecified.

tradeSpecies.description: Species to trade for. Null when unspecified.

turnUpsideDown.description: Whether the device must be upside down. Null when unspecified.

usedMove.description: Move that must be used. Null when unspecified.

versionGroup.description: Version group that introduced this method. Null when unspecified.

item.description: First alternative evolution item. Null when unspecified.

minLevel.description: First alternative minimum level. Null when unspecified.

trigger.description: First alternative trigger, or base for the root stage.

items.description: Ability entry with effect text and hidden-ability flag.

effectText.description: Full English effect description. Null when unavailable.

isHidden.description: True when this is the hidden ability.

shortEffectText.description: Short English effect description. Null when unavailable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The identifier matches no Pokémon record and no species. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

evolutionChain.description: Evolution tree rooted at the base species.

genderRate.description: Gender ratio: -1 genderless, 0 always male, 8 always female, 1–7 fraction (eighths) female.

genus.description: English genus (e.g. "Seed Pokémon"). Null when unavailable.

id.description: PokéAPI Pokémon-record ID. Form IDs are not National Pokédex numbers.

moveCount.description: Total number of learnable moves regardless of include_moves.

moves.description: Learnable moves (populated when include_moves=true, empty otherwise).

items.description: Move summary entry — name, learn method, and level.

learnMethod.description: How the move is learned (level-up, machine, egg, tutor).

levelLearnedAt.description: Level at which the move is learned. Zero for non-level-up methods.

name.description: Canonical Pokémon name in hyphenated lowercase.

resolvedFromSpecies.description: Species name the identifier matched when it named no Pokémon record; this dossier is the default variety of that species. Null when the identifier named a Pokémon record directly.

speciesFlavorText.description: Flavor text from the selected (or most recent) game version. Null when none available.

name.description: Stat name (hp, attack, defense, special-attack, special-defense, speed).

varieties.description: All forms and variants of this species.

items.description: Form or variant entry with name and default flag.

title: Get Pokémon
